title: Husayn ibn Ali is killed at the Battle of Karbala
summary: A small group led by Husayn ibn Ali, grandson of Muhammad, was surrounded and killed by an Umayyad army at Karbala. The women and children of his family were taken captive.
reason: Husayn refused to accept Yazid I as caliph and was travelling to Kufa, where supporters had invited him to lead them.
significance: His death is mourned every year on Ashura and became central to Shia Islam.
